map.没有电流斑就能排除电击吗？: Does no current mark rule out electrocution?
map.不能。高压电弧、水中触电、接触时间短或湿性皮肤可无明显电流斑；应结合电气通路、金: No. High-voltage arc, water electrocution, short contact time or wet skin may show no clear current mark; should combine electrical path, metal deposition (SEM-EDX) and on-site circuit.
map.电流斑能区分交流和直流吗？: Can current marks distinguish AC from DC?
map.典型电流斑多见于交流；直流多为灰白凹陷伴电解烧伤，形态不具绝对特异性，需结合电压: Typical current marks are more common in AC; DC is mostly gray-white depression with electrolytic burns, morphology is not absolutely specific, needs voltage/current type and histology.
